harvest: One-repo-one-truth and no unversioned best-code remain foundational cleanliness laws.
Verification must report the same endpoint/config the runtime actually uses; configuration knobs that only diagnostics read are false confidence.
Fresh-clone survival matters: runtime capabilities cannot depend on hidden sibling checkouts or state-only registrations.
PASS do-not-merge queues need bounded closure; verified work stranded outside canonical Git is operational debt.
External numeric claims require verified source/freshness, reinforced independently by othrys-tools.
Historical tarballs are recovery evidence, not active development source.
Transfer tarballs are transport artifacts, not canonical source.
Old locks/dedupe staging belong outside active Projects.
Panda lab confirms the already-harvested scale-aware Planner, explicit design gate, Builder/Reviewer separation, blocker visibility and non-constitutional complexity heuristics.
Its dependency payload is tooling/vendor state, not OTHRYS source.
